adjudicated.ruling: Lowercase, with handmissal-eo and with the typical edition. The capital in do is its reverential capitalisation of the pronoun of Christ — its own cross-split words print lowercase (sancti + ficas) — where this edition follows the books it edits. The same ruling governs w005 and w008.
